summary.text: This tour maps Taylor Swift's fanbase across five US cities with strong room affinity (73–76), all near Qloo fan hotspots. The audience skews toward pop, melodic and emotional themes, with shared tastes in folk, blues, piano and country across stops.

why.text: Charleston has a 76 room affinity and sits near a Qloo fan hotspot. The audience shares melodic, blues, piano and folk tastes. The Commodore, Uptown Social, The Drop-In Bar & Deli and Music Farm are venues the fans favour.

pitch.text:
Subject: Taylor Swift – Charleston stop

We're bringing Taylor Swift to Charleston. The fanbase here has strong affinity for venues like yours, and they're drawn to melodic, blues and piano-led music. We'd like to approach Demi Lovato as a suggested opener. This audience loves pop and emotional storytelling—a natural fit for your room and programming.

summary.text: This tour maps Taylor Swift's fanbase across five US cities with strong room affinity (73–76), all near Qloo fan hotspots. The audience skews toward pop, melodic and emotional themes, with shared tastes in folk, blues, piano and country across stops.

theme.text: "Folklore & Stories" – Centre each show on Taylor's narrative storytelling tradition, leaning into the blues, folk and piano-rich production that resonates across all five stops, with minimal production to spotlight lyrics.

"Melodic Hearts" – Build around intimate, emotionally direct performances that emphasise the simple, melodic and acoustic guitar elements all five audiences favour, creating space for emotional connection.

"Genre Mosaic" – Showcase Taylor's genre-blending (pop, country, jazz, blues), rotating setlist emphasis by city to highlight the specific shared tastes each stop values—folk and country in Charleston, Pittsburgh and Jacksonville; jazz in Boston; emotional pop in Orlando.

merch.text: Branded collaboration pieces with Keds, Gap, Urban Outfitters or American Eagle Outfitters—limited-edition Taylor apparel or accessories that tie to fan lifestyle brands they already favour.
Tour edition vinyl or deluxe CDs featuring city-specific or theme-specific bonus tracks, appealing to the melodic and album-focused nature of the audience.
Starbucks gift cards or co-branded cups bundled with exclusive digital content, connecting to the brand affinity data and creating repeat purchase appeal.

risks.text: Venues listed are curated by Qloo taste data but are not confirmed bookings. Availability, competing shows and booking conflicts may affect tour viability.
Tour routing across Charleston, Orlando, Pittsburgh, Jacksonville and Boston requires logistics and scheduling coordination; dates and promotion timing will shape actual audience turnout.
